python - <<'PY'
import json
from pathlib import Path
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np

base = Path('/app/benchmark')
out = Path('/app/output/result.png')

with open(base/'task_input.json') as f:
    task = json.load(f)
with open(base/'source_data.json') as f:
    data = json.load(f)

insight = task['goal']['insight']
style = task.get('style', {})

inv = data['ai_investment']['data']
years = [d['year'] for d in inv]
vals = [d['investment'] for d in inv]

# Professional palette aligned to dark futuristic style in task_input
bg = '#0b1020'
ax_bg = '#111831'
text = '#e6ecff'
muted = '#9fb0d9'
line = '#62a5ff'
fill = '#2f6fd6'
accent = '#ffd166'

plt.rcParams.update({
    'font.family': 'DejaVu Sans',
    'figure.facecolor': bg,
    'axes.facecolor': ax_bg,
    'axes.edgecolor': '#33446e',
    'axes.labelcolor': text,
    'xtick.color': muted,
    'ytick.color': muted,
    'text.color': text,
})

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(14, 8), dpi=180)

x = np.array(years)
y = np.array(vals)

ax.plot(x, y, color=line, linewidth=3.0, marker='o', markersize=4.5, label='Private AI investment')
ax.fill_between(x, y, color=fill, alpha=0.28)

# Emphasize acceleration period
mask = x >= 2023
ax.plot(x[mask], y[mask], color=accent, linewidth=3.5, marker='o', markersize=6, label='Acceleration phase (2023–2025)')

ax.set_title('AI Investment Growth Surges as Industry Adoption and Regulation Intensify (2010–2025)', fontsize=20, pad=18, weight='bold')
ax.set_xlabel('Year', fontsize=13, labelpad=10)
ax.set_ylabel('Global private AI investment (billion USD)', fontsize=13, labelpad=10)

ax.grid(True, axis='y', linestyle='--', linewidth=0.8, alpha=0.35, color='#6f84b7')
ax.grid(False, axis='x')

ax.set_xlim(2009.5, 2025.5)
ax.set_ylim(0, max(vals) * 1.16)

# Key annotation from the dataset-supported trend
start_2010 = vals[0]
end_2025 = vals[-1]
multiple = end_2025 / start_2010
ax.annotate(
    f'{end_2025:.1f}B USD in 2025\n(~{multiple:.0f}× vs 2010)',
    xy=(2025, end_2025), xycoords='data',
    xytext=(2019.2, end_2025*0.83), textcoords='data',
    arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color=accent, lw=1.8),
    fontsize=11.5, color='#ffe29a',
    bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.35', fc='#2a2240', ec=accent, alpha=0.92)
)

# Legend
leg = ax.legend(loc='upper left', frameon=True, facecolor='#1a2548', edgecolor='#4f6197', fontsize=11)
for t in leg.get_texts():
    t.set_color(text)

# Source note
fig.text(0.012, 0.018, 'Source: /app/benchmark/source_data.json (ai_investment, 2010–2025)', color=muted, fontsize=10)

plt.tight_layout(rect=[0, 0.03, 1, 1])
out.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
plt.savefig(out, dpi=180, facecolor=fig.get_facecolor())
plt.close(fig)
print(out)
print('Insight:', insight)
PY

python - <<'PY'
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont
import json, math
from pathlib import Path

base = Path('/app/benchmark')
out = Path('/app/output/result.png')

with open(base/'task_input.json') as f:
    task = json.load(f)
with open(base/'source_data.json') as f:
    data = json.load(f)

inv = data['ai_investment']['data']
years = [d['year'] for d in inv]
vals = [d['investment'] for d in inv]

W,H = 2200,1300
img = Image.new('RGB',(W,H),'#0b1020')
d = ImageDraw.Draw(img)

# colors
ax_bg='#111831'; text='#e6ecff'; muted='#9fb0d9'; line='#62a5ff'; fill='#2f6fd6'; accent='#ffd166'; grid='#6f84b7'

# fonts
try:
    f_title = ImageFont.truetype('/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans-Bold.ttf',54)
    f_label = ImageFont.truetype('/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans.ttf',34)
    f_tick = ImageFont.truetype('/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans.ttf',24)
    f_legend = ImageFont.truetype('/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans.ttf',26)
    f_note = ImageFont.truetype('/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans.ttf',22)
except:
    f_title=f_label=f_tick=f_legend=f_note=ImageFont.load_default()

# plot area
left,top,right,bottom = 180,180,2080,1080

# bg panel
d.rounded_rectangle((120,120,2140,1140), radius=24, fill=ax_bg, outline='#33446e', width=3)

# scales
xmin,xmax=min(years),max(years)
ymin,ymax=0,max(vals)*1.16

def sx(x): return left + (x-xmin)/(xmax-xmin)*(right-left)
def sy(y): return bottom - (y-ymin)/(ymax-ymin)*(bottom-top)

# y grid/ticks
for t in [0,20,40,60,80,100,120,140]:
    y=sy(t)
    if top<=y<=bottom:
        d.line((left,y,right,y), fill=grid, width=1)
        d.text((left-70,y-12), f'{t}', fill=muted, font=f_tick)

# x ticks
for yr in years:
    x=sx(yr)
    d.line((x,bottom,x,bottom+10), fill=muted, width=2)
    if yr%2==0:
        d.text((x-26,bottom+18), str(yr), fill=muted, font=f_tick)

# axes
d.line((left,top,left,bottom), fill='#a7b7df', width=3)
d.line((left,bottom,right,bottom), fill='#a7b7df', width=3)

# area polygon
pts=[(sx(y),sy(v)) for y,v in zip(years,vals)]
poly=[(sx(years[0]),bottom)] + pts + [(sx(years[-1]),bottom)]
d.polygon(poly, fill=fill)

# line
for i in range(len(pts)-1):
    d.line((pts[i],pts[i+1]), fill=line, width=6)
for p in pts:
    d.ellipse((p[0]-6,p[1]-6,p[0]+6,p[1]+6), fill=line)

# accent segment 2023-2025
idx=[i for i,y in enumerate(years) if y>=2023]
for i in idx[:-1]:
    d.line((pts[i],pts[i+1]), fill=accent, width=7)
for i in idx:
    p=pts[i]
    d.ellipse((p[0]-8,p[1]-8,p[0]+8,p[1]+8), fill=accent)

# title and labels
title='AI Investment Growth Surges as Industry Adoption and Regulation Intensify (2010–2025)'
d.text((150,38), title, fill=text, font=f_title)
d.text((940,1160), 'Year', fill=text, font=f_label)
d.text((20,560), 'Global private AI investment (billion USD)', fill=text, font=f_label)

# legend
lx,ly=1460,220
d.rectangle((lx,ly,lx+560,ly+130), fill='#1a2548', outline='#4f6197', width=2)
d.line((lx+24,ly+38,lx+100,ly+38), fill=line, width=6)
d.text((lx+120,ly+20),'Private AI investment',fill=text,font=f_legend)
d.line((lx+24,ly+92,lx+100,ly+92), fill=accent, width=6)
d.text((lx+120,ly+74),'Acceleration phase (2023–2025)',fill=text,font=f_legend)

# annotation
start,end=vals[0],vals[-1]
mult=end/start
ax,ay=sx(2025),sy(end)
box=(1260,560,1800,700)
d.rounded_rectangle(box, radius=16, fill='#2a2240', outline=accent, width=3)
d.text((1284,590), f'{end:.1f}B USD in 2025 (~{mult:.0f}× vs 2010)', fill='#ffe29a', font=f_legend)
d.line((1800,630,ax-12,ay+6), fill=accent, width=3)

# source note
d.text((130,1188),'Source: /app/benchmark/source_data.json (ai_investment, billion USD)', fill=muted, font=f_note)

out.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
img.save(out)
print(out)
PY
